description: MainFragment class for an Android app, managing UI interactions, navigation, and attachments in a notes application.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing main notes UI, including navigation, attachment handling, and menu actions.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up UI components, and registers result listeners.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and sets up menu items.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for search, layout, sorting, and other actions.

methods.name: actionToEditor
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the editor screen with specified parameters.

methods.name: actionToSearch
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the search screen with optional query.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles note click events to open the note in editor.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click events on notes to show context menu.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on selection state.

methods.name: onLayoutModeChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when layout mode changes.

methods.name: onSortMethodChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when sort method changes.

methods.name: goToEditor
methods.description: Navigates to the note editor with optional note ID and attachments.

methods.name: setupFab
methods.description: Configures the floating action button for creating new notes.

methods.name: setLayoutChangeActionIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for layout toggle based on current layout mode.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Highlights the current sort method in the menu.

methods.name: setupBottomAppBar
methods.description: Configures bottom app bar menu actions for creating lists, recording audio, attaching files, and taking photos.
